$comment: Single source of truth for K3s homelab node identity and safety constraints. Consumed by WindowsLab/HomelabNodes.psm1 -> Start-K3sHomelab.ps1, Stop-K3sHomelab-Minimal.ps1, shutdown_homelab.ps1. Do not hardcode node lists in those scripts. Decommissioned 2026-10-17: kubernetes7 was removed from the cluster by owner decision - its physical power switch is unrecoverable, so the machine can never return to service. Its MACs (6c:c2:17:e9:a4:e5 on 192.168.0.26 primary, 90:48:9a:df:2c:10 on 192.168.0.104 second NIC) must not be reassigned to other hosts.

nodes.name: nuc
nodes.notes: K3s control plane and API server endpoint. Never cordon/drain: the API lives here.

nodes.name: kubernetes1
nodes.notes: General worker. Hosts iiq db-mysql after recovery.

nodes.name: kubernetes2
nodes.notes: General worker. Hosts iiq db after recovery.

nodes.name: kubernetes5
nodes.notes: Minimal-mode survivor (kept running with nuc + kubernetes7 during power-down).

nodes.name: kubernetes8-debian
nodes.notes: Debian worker. Frequently powered off during minimal mode; expect it NotReady with stale Longhorn instance-managers.

nodes.name: server-236
nodes.notes: 2nd K3s server (embedded etcd), joined 2026-09-19. HP-1 host. Also runs the local Docker registry on :5000 (pinned by kube-system/registry-fixer), so it must not be wiped.

nodes.name: server-252
nodes.notes: 3rd K3s server (embedded etcd), joined 2026-09-20. Hyper-V VM (actual VM name k3s-master-2, guest hostname k3s-master, 2 vCPU / dynamic memory 3-6 GB since 2026-10-17) on the Lenovo ThinkCentre host (192.168.0.170, 8 GB RAM, also runs Podman) - completes 3-member etcd quorum. SSH user is lowercase suryendub (verified live 2026-10-17; capital-S SuryenduB is rejected - unlike server-236). Registering it here means the minimal-mode survivor list MUST keep a control-plane majority (see survivors).

external.name: registry
external.notes: Local docker registry on port 5000; pinned by kube-system/registry-fixer. Since 2026-09-19 it is co-hosted on the control-plane node 'server-236' (the planned move to 192.168.0.249 never happened - .249 does not exist on this LAN).
